map.优等品是怎么判出来的？: How is the top-grade product determined?
map.先要求抗压与抗折两项都达到对应限值（合格），在此基础上若抗压强度还达到限值的 1: First require both compressive and flexural strength to meet their limits (conforming); on that basis, premium grade requires compressive strength to reach at least 1.3x the limit. When only both items pass it is first-class. Limits differ by material: general cement 32.5/5.0, concrete 30.0/4.0, fired brick 15.0/3.0, blocks 5.0/1.0 MPa.
map.执行的标准为什么随材料类型变？: Why does the applied standard change with material type?
map.不同建材有各自的国家标准：通用水泥用 GB/T 175，混凝土用 GB/T 50: Different building materials have their own national standards: general cement uses GB/T 175, concrete GB/T 50081, fired bricks GB/T 5101, blocks GB/T 11968. After you pick the material type the tool switches to the matching standard and limits, avoiding misapplied criteria and misjudgement.
